productsAndServices.description: An online secure repository for storing and sharing confidential documents during transactions, enabling remote due diligence with controlled access and real-time monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual Data Room Due Diligence

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive evaluation process assessing a company’s financial, legal, operational, HR, and tax status to identify risks and validate data before transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Due Diligence Audit Service

productsAndServices.description: A systematic evaluation of a company’s technology infrastructure, software, and cybersecurity to identify risks and growth opportunities during due diligence.
productsAndServices.name: Technology Assessment in Due Diligence

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $825,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,325,000 to $4,325,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
